limits: Reduced contact model, not full3D joint or surface pressure analysis
Guide walls are uncoupled linear foundations; support stiffness and friction are illustrative assumptions
Uniform rod omits cross hole and collar; no nonlinear material or actual fastener contact
Applied folded-land load represented by a transverse point resultant at its midpoint
Coulomb drag is an upper sliding resistance estimate from normal reactions; no dynamic stick slip, chamfer centering or actual spring return trajectory
Positive assumed force margin is not a validated product pass or predicted probability
No grade, friction, load, life, fatigue or user comfort qualification
